species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 45°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 2–20 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 45°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
